name: Corpus Search
description: Provision and search a sampled, provenance-aware multi-source metadata corpus with SQLite FTS5/BM25.
capabilities: search scientific paper metadata by topic, category and date
search papers with quoted phrases, exclusions, alternatives and field prefixes
look up an exact arXiv record with its abstract and links
resolve an exact Wikipedia article title and its link
resolve a subject named in plain language to its arXiv category identifier
report the local corpus coverage, sources, freshness and record counts
catch the installed corpus up with newly published records

profileIds.description: Packaged profiles to compose into one corpus, at most one per source.

categories.description: Optional arXiv topics that replace the packaged topic list of every selected profile that accepts topics.
